specificationDescription: All task executions must track impulse loading and creation to learn optimal context strategies. Records impulses_loaded (array of impulse IDs), impulses_created (array of new impulse IDs), and context_ratio (context tokens / total tokens) per task to enable learning what context is useful.
expectedBehavior: Every task execution PATCHes /api/v1/tasks/:id with impulses_loaded (non-empty array when impulses used), impulses_created (array when new impulses created), context_ratio (number between 0-1 representing context efficiency)

working: Backend receives impulses_loaded and impulses_created arrays
Impulse IDs are correctly tracked during task execution
State delta computation detects newly created impulses
UsageStats schema is defined in ActivityTemplate.Impulse
broken: Local usageStats never updated (loadCount, totalCost, totalTokens always 0)
context_ratio not calculated or sent to backend
tokens sent as single number instead of {input, output, cache} breakdown
UI shows empty impulse usage (filtered out because loadCount is 0)

components.currentBehavior: Loads impulses in parallel using ImpulseResolver, updates activityImpulses dict with loaded content, but does NOT update usageStats
components.desiredBehavior: After loading each impulse, update usageStats.loadCount++, usageStats.totalTokens += tokenCount, set firstAccessedAt/lastAccessedAt timestamps
components.gap: CRITICAL - Missing usageStats update after line 98 (after loading impulse)
components.fixCode: const loadedImpulse = loadedImpulses[i]!; loadedImpulse.usageStats ??= { loadCount: 0, totalCost: 0, totalTokens: 0 }; loadedImpulse.usageStats.loadCount++; loadedImpulse.usageStats.totalTokens += loadedImpulse.tokenCount || 0; loadedImpulse.usageStats.firstAccessedAt ??= Date.now(); loadedImpulse.usageStats.lastAccessedAt = Date.now(); activityImpulses[impulseIds[i]] = loadedImpulse

components.currentBehavior: Detects newly created impulses via set difference (impulsesAfterTask - impulsesBeforeTask), but does NOT initialize usageStats for new impulses
components.desiredBehavior: After detecting created impulses, initialize usageStats for each new impulse with loadCount=0, totalCost=0, totalTokens=0, timestamps
components.gap: MEDIUM - Missing usageStats initialization for newly created impulses
components.fixCode: for (const impulseId of impulsesCreated) { const impulse = _activity.impulses[impulseId]; if (impulse) { impulse.usageStats = { loadCount: 0, totalCost: 0, totalTokens: 0, firstAccessedAt: Date.now(), lastAccessedAt: Date.now() }; } }

components.currentBehavior: Reports executionId, stepOrder, success, durationMs, cost, tokens (as number), impulsesLoaded, impulsesCreated. Does NOT send context_ratio. Does NOT update local usageStats after backend report.
components.desiredBehavior: Calculate context_ratio = impulse_tokens / total_input_tokens, send to backend. After backend report, update local usageStats.totalCost for each impulse
components.gap: HIGH - Missing context_ratio calculation and local usageStats.totalCost update
components.fixCode: const impulseTokens = (task.impulseReferences || []).map(id => _activity.impulses[id]?.tokenCount || 0).reduce((sum, t) => sum + t, 0); const contextRatio = tokens.input > 0 ? impulseTokens / tokens.input : 0;

components.currentBehavior: Does NOT update local usageStats after backend report completes
components.desiredBehavior: After backend report, distribute task cost across used impulses and update usageStats.totalCost
components.gap: HIGH - Missing dual-write pattern (backend updated, local not updated)
components.fixLocation: After line 2577 (after reportExecutionStep call, inside try block)
components.fixCode: const costPerImpulse = cost / Math.max(task.impulseReferences?.length || 0, 1); for (const impulseId of task.impulseReferences || []) { const impulse = _activity.impulses[impulseId]; if (impulse?.usageStats) { impulse.usageStats.totalCost += costPerImpulse; } }; await Activity.save(_activity)

components.currentBehavior: Accepts tokens as number, does NOT accept context_ratio parameter
components.desiredBehavior: Accept tokens as {input, output, cache} breakdown, accept context_ratio parameter, send both to backend
components.gap: HIGH - Missing context_ratio parameter, incorrect tokens type
components.fixCode: Change tokens: number to tokens: { input: number; output: number; cache: number }, add contextRatio?: number parameter

components.currentBehavior: Reads usageStats from impulses, aggregates across activities, filters out impulses with loadCount=0 (which is everything because usageStats is never updated)
components.desiredBehavior: Should work correctly once upstream components write to usageStats
components.gap: LOW - No gap, just depends on upstream fixes
components.fixCode: N/A - Works correctly once upstream components update usageStats

dataFlow: Task Start → loadImpulsesForTask [UPDATE usageStats.loadCount] → Execute Task → Compute State Delta [INIT usageStats for new impulses] → Calculate context_ratio → reportExecutionStep to backend [SEND context_ratio] → Update local usageStats.totalCost → Save Activity → Aggregate Session State → Display in UI

critical: usageStats never updated during impulse loading (task-execution-shared.ts:98)
high: Local usageStats.totalCost not updated after backend report (activity.ts:2577)
tokens sent as number instead of breakdown (metabob.ts:914)
medium: usageStats not initialized for newly created impulses (activity.ts:2561)
